limitations: Diagnostic candidate only; no predetermined old-token rejection or automatic approval.
Official REST/policy/privacy snapshots are reused with their original hashes/times; manage-sessions was fetched for this slice.

0/10/30-second targets and 45-second request-start deadline are finite harness bounds, not documented propagation guarantees. Socket/processing timeout is not hard real-time cancellation; in-flight workers drain before cleanup.
Decoded iat/auth_time and account validSince are unverified timing metadata. Token raw bytes/digests and private identity are not published.
Same-second boundaries, refresh lineage after rotation, no-change longitudinal controls, SDK checkRevoked, Rules, elapsed expiry, MFA, physical devices and fault-injected recovery remain unverified.
Earlier approved password/basic/profile/aggregation evidence remains unchanged. Broad Auth and public npm labels are not promoted.

preconditions.condition: Require exact client schemaVersion 1, enforcementState ENFORCE, minPasswordLength 6 and maxPasswordLength 4096; admin config must omit passwordPolicyConfig. This explicit readback is not inferred OFF. Distinct 47-character generated passwords have uppercase/lowercase/numeric/non-alphanumeric characters; no configuration is changed.

interpretation.condition: SDK checkRevoked is a separate verification route. General revocation descriptions do not establish uniform immediate REST rejection. Observe A/B/fresh lanes independently; retain differences and bounded non-rejection without promoting them to whole-session claims.
